subject: Request: Quarterly invoicing + short-term Net-90 bridge for Aurora pilot
messages:
From: Dana Keller <dana.keller@aurorahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: invoice cadence for pilot + payment window

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the great demo last week — Aurora is excited to start the three-month pilot for our outpatient scheduling team. Procurement flagged one operational constraint on our side: our fiscal team consolidates vendor payments to a quarterly cycle, so we need invoices to be issued on a quarterly schedule and paid on Net-90 after invoice.

Is Redwood able to accommodate quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for the pilot term? If not, would you consider a short-term bridge (one quarter) while we onboard to your standard monthly cycle after the pilot? We can provide a PO in advance or an assurance letter if that helps.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call to make this easier.

Best,
Dana Keller
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Health

Attachments: Aurora_PO_Template.docx (attachment stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: invoice cadence for pilot + payment window

Karthik / Naomi — looping you in. Aurora (pilot, potential mid-market expansion) is asking for quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for the pilot quarter to align with their internal AP. They offered a PO or assurance letter up-front.

Summary / proposal:
- Term: 3-month pilot starting 6/1/2027.
- Ask: issue one invoice at end of quarter (7/31) and Aurora pays Net-90 (so payment ~10/29).
- Revenue risk: single large receivable delayed ~90 days; est invoice ~$85k for pilot.
- Suggested bridge/controls: accept a conditional Net-90 for this pilot only with one of the following required before go-live:
  1) 25% prepay (preferred), OR
  2) Signed PO + purchase order number + ACH payment authorization on file, OR
  3) Escrow of first-quarter funds to Redwood's custodian.
- Additional ask: require DocuSign amendment to contract documenting the temporary cadence, cap the exposure at $250k, and add a late-payment interest of 1%/month after 120 days.

Can Finance sign off on the controls (Naomi) and can we get exec sign-off for a one-quarter Net-90 exception? If yes I'll share amendment and coordinate with legal/ops to set billing schedule.

Thanks — Marcus
Head of Sales, East
Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:15 AM Dana Keller <dana.keller@aurorahealth.com> wrote:

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: invoice cadence for pilot + payment window

Marcus — reviewed the exposure. Finance is OK to approve a one-quarter Net-90 bridge provided we have one of the controls you listed. Practical checklist for approval:
- PO number on file OR 25% prepay received by 5/25/2027.
- DocuSign amendment executed that clearly states this is a one-time exception for the pilot and that standard monthly invoicing resumes after 7/31/2027.
- Billing team to create special invoice template and flag account for collections outreach starting 60 days post-invoice.

If we'd like a faster path, a 15% prepay is acceptable only if Karthik confirms discount doesn't exceed approved deal thresholds. Otherwise require 25%.

Naomi
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: invoice cadence for pilot + payment window

Approved with conditions — escalating to inform Marcus to proceed with conditional amendment. Executive decision: allow one-quarter quarterly invoicing with Net-90 for Aurora pilot under these firm conditions:
1) Exposure cap: $250,000 cumulative for this account (pilot invoice est $85k).
2) Financial control: 20% prepayment received before go-live OR an incoming PO with explicit payment guarantee and ACH mandate on file.
3) Legal doc: DocuSign amendment executed that describes the temporary cadence, sets auto-revert to monthly billing after 7/31/2027, and includes the 1%/month late interest after 120 days.
4) No discount change: any commercial discount must stay within existing deal guidelines — Karthik, confirm final pricing.
5) Billing ops: create a flagged invoice template and collection playbook.

Marcus — you have exec sign-off to offer the above to Aurora. Please copy legal@redwood.com on the amendment and Naomi on prepay confirmation. Once amendment signed and PO/prepay received, billing will schedule the single Q2 invoice for 2027-07-31.

Jonas Weber
VP Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Next steps: I'll send the amendment via DocuSign immediately and attach the SOW and payment-plan spreadsheet. Please confirm whether Aurora will provide a PO or 20% prepay and we will route the DocuSign for signature.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.

Marcus Lin
